recipe.title: Creamy spinach and Parmesan orzo
recipe.serves: Serves four (or halve everything except the onion for a two-person dinner).

i.n: garlic, minced, or use crushed garlic
Parmesan cheese, grated, plus more for serving

method.s: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and sauté until softened, about three minutes.
Add garlic, orzo and pepper and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in chicken stock and milk, then bring to a gentle boil.

Cover, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is al dente and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes or according to packet instructions. Add more liquid if the orzo is still too firm.
Stir in the spinach and Parmesan until the spinach has just wilted and the cheese melts, about 1 minute.
Garnish with pepper and more cheese if desired.
